img-chen-portrait.attribution: Photo of Tianqi Chen, from his personal academic homepage at tqchen.com (Carnegie Mellon University).
img-chen-portrait.alt: Portrait photo of Tianqi Chen, author of XGBoost. Currently Assistant Professor at CMU.

img-friedman-portrait.method: hand-coded SVG, dark-navy palette, stylized silhouette with bio sidebar
img-friedman-portrait.alt: Stylized portrait card for Jerome H. Friedman (Stanford Statistics), summarizing his contributions to CART, MARS, projection pursuit, and the 2001 Gradient Boosting Machine paper.
img-friedman-portrait.note: No freely-licensed photo of Jerome Friedman was located on Wikimedia Commons or other open-license sources; the SVG silhouette is used in lieu of a copyrighted portrait. Matches the project's stylized-portrait style established in flash-sintering-2.

diag-adaboost-weighted-vote.method: hand-coded SVG, 1920x1080, dark-navy palette (#0e1117 bg, #58a6ff tree icons, #ffd866 weights, #f97583 final-classifier accent)
diag-adaboost-weighted-vote.alt: Schematic of AdaBoost (Freund & Schapire 1996): three decision-stump weak classifiers h_1, h_2, h_3, each with its own vote weight alpha_i, summing into the final classifier H(x) = sign(sum alpha_i h_i(x)).
